scope: Unchanged upstream wesmar/minesweeper x86 release run through the ordinary browser harness. This records window and paint progress, not full gameplay.
runtimeWork: RegisterClass accepts cbWndExtra/cbClsExtra and a class menu name
standard MENU templates parse with NUL-terminated strings after MENUHEADER
LoadString uses Wine's (id >> 4) + 1 block and id & 0x0f entry arithmetic
CreateFont accepts the charset/quality/pitch hints every application passes
GetSystemMetrics answers the full defined metric table
AdjustWindowRect(Ex) accounts for a menu bar
MoveWindow routes through the shared positioning path
remaining: The game reaches its own message loop and paints its dialog chrome; interactive play (menu commands, cell clicks) is not yet verified.
